# TikTym

> TikTym: 100 minutes a day for your productive life. A free habit tracker for working professionals in India: 30 minutes to move, 30 to read, 30 to grow and 10 to breathe. Say what you did and its AI logs it; busy days carry forward without piling up. It runs in the browser, installs to the home screen on iPhone and Android, and works offline.

## What it does

- 100 minutes a day as the recommended start: Exercise 30, Reading 30, Course study 30, Meditation 10, the practices every new account begins with; each person can change them.
- Log by voice with AI: tap the microphone and say what you did ("ran 20 minutes and read for half an hour"); Google's Gemini turns it into entries the person checks before saving. The recording isn't stored.
- Every minute you log counts: log by voice, with one tap, or let the focus timer log the minutes.
- Busy weeks carry forward, but never pile up: missed minutes carry into the next day, up to a limit you choose (two days of the target by default); older misses are forgiven.
- One balanced daily target across learning, health and a calm mind, instead of a long list of habits.
- Streaks with shields: three clear days in a row earn a shield (up to three), which keeps the streak on a missed day; a calendar shows clear, shielded and missed days.
- Insights (worked out from the person's own numbers, not AI): streaks, consistency over 16 weeks, and the time of day you practise best; a shareable monthly progress card.
- New accounts choose their practices first (for example Course study, Reading, Exercise, Meditation, Coding practice, Language learning).

## Facts

- Price: free, no ads.
- Platforms: any modern browser; add to the home screen for an app-like experience. A Google Play listing is planned.
- Data: stored in India; never sold; export or delete any time. Voice recordings go to Google's Gemini to be understood and are not stored.
- Made in India.
